PZZ700-172045-
120 AM PDT Sat Oct 17 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1039 mb high was centered over the Texas panhandle and
a 1011 mb low was over Punta Abreojos, Mexico. Moderate offshore 
flow this morning will slowly decrease through today becoming
weak by tonight. Isolated gusts exceeding 20 knots are expected 
through this morning. Onshore flow returns from Sunday onward, but
may briefly turn weakly offshore again Sunday night. Southerly 
flow will increase Wednesday as a weather system arrives. 

$$
